mapper.select: SELECT SUM(nvl(T.AMOUNT,0)) POSITION, nvl(FP.ISSUE_AMT,0) ISSUEAMT FROM FIN_PRODUCT FP LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_POSITION T ON FP.FINPROD_ID = T.FINPROD_ID AND T.CDATE = to_date(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND T.HODING_TYPE = #{hodingType03} WHERE FP.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} GROUP BY T.FINPROD_ID, FP.ISSUE_AMT
